Prior to discharge, sodium bisulfite is added to the treated effluent to remove residual chlorine. The Facility also has a backup sodium bisulfite dechlorination system. Treated wastewater discharged to San Gabriel River and San Jose Creek is dechlorinated.

No facilities are provided for solids processing at the plant. Sewage solids separated from the wastewater are returned to the trunk sewer for conveyance to JWPCP for treatment and disposal under Order Number R4-2017-0180 (NPDES Number CA0053813).
